blocks.text: Philippine delegate Bea Millan-Windorski turned emotional during her reunion with her parents, just a few days before competing in the 2026 Miss Universe finals night in Puerto Rico. The Filipino-American beauty queen broke into in tears as she and her mother shared a long, tight hug, as seen in the video shared by the Miss Universe Philippines organization on its Facebook page on Monday, Nov. 23. Her father later joined the embrace while pageant fans around them cheered for Bea.
